evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: in order for us to give you a prefer code normally, we ask a few questions to get you under way track this should take about five to ten minutes of your time then we'll be able to build an accurate quote. You can depend on, sounds good. — asked but rushed through without waiting for customer confirmation before launching into probing
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call today? — asked after the rep had already started gathering availability and logistics info
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep acknowledged customer's concern about boxes needing to be replaced and water damage context ('I see, sorry to hear that my condolences') but did not probe deeper with follow-up questions like 'tell me more about that' or 'what specifically worries you most'; moved quickly to data gathering instead
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Rep said 'I'll also put a notification for bringing boxes in case needed' — acknowledged the concern but did not synthesize and reflect back all concerns as a summary, just addressed one item in isolation
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: typical ten by fifteen storage unit would normally take two movers that is between five and a half hours to seven and a half hours to completely move but in your case we are moving on the same location with different storage unit. So we will send out two movers and one truck estimated time is between four to five hours estimated cost in case they end up five hours would be $1,160 — gave typical range and personalized to same-location move
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: trip fee of 140 dollars only because the location is outside there free travel zone — disclosed trip fee upfront; also covered no hidden fees, 2.5-hour minimum, and 15-minute-increment proration
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moved directly from pricing explanation into availability window ('for tomorrow we can be able to book your slot as early as 8:30 AM') without asking if the estimate felt fair or pausing for customer reaction
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: we have on time. Guarantee. We value your time so fully if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill — discount terms clearly stated
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: no worry damage coverage... we will cover it up to $2,000 per move. That is the repair, replace and reimbursed for your items... there's no hidden fees of any type — delivered coverage amount and no-hidden-fees framing; did not explicitly state 'no deductible' or 'no fine print'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Does not close loop. Rep delivered both promises but never asked 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent; moved directly into availability and booking without confirming the two promises answered the customer's concerns
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Do you have any other questions or any concerns that you want me to address during this call? — genuine version asked
evidence_quotes.followup_on_remaining_concern: Customer raised concern about cords and shop backs at storage location ('they'll just have to be a little bit careful... they do have lots of cords'). Rep responded 'Okay, no worries. I'll let them know as soon as we can' — acknowledged and committed to passing it to crew; minimal follow-up but did engage
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. Rep did not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or similar catch-all
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: would you like our help with your move for tomorrow? — asked plainly without a built-in out
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: there's no deposit required, no rest and securing your spot — rate lock / no-deposit mentioned
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date (tomorrow 8:30–9:00 AM), phone number (not explicitly re-confirmed in final booking summary, only mentioned 'just give us a call'), arrival window (8:30–9:00 AM), crew size (2 movers and 1 truck), addresses (house address 16523 Oat Mill Drive and storage unit B109 to B188), and notes to crew about cords/shop backs mentioned — most elements confirmed but phone number not re-stated in final summary

top_strength: Excellent probing discipline — the rep gathered all seven logistics items (property type, floor/stories, room count, walk distance, special items, box count, and additional stops/rooms) and confirmed the multi-stop itinerary (house pickup + storage unit move) with clear route reasoning.
coaching_note: Section 4's 'Does that feel fair?' pause was skipped entirely; rep moved straight from $1,160 estimate into availability, missing the critical 3-point silence moment that lets the customer land on pricing before moving forward.
